aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.borrowed_: While worn, prepare rank 1 Invisibility. It costs mana and shares the learned spell’s cooldown. Removing the ring ends its invisibility.
While worn, prepare rank 1 Frostwave. It costs mana and shares the learned spell’s cooldown.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.stored_br: Prepare Stored Breath while wearing the necklace. Breathe air for two seconds to charge it. Release it underwater for yourself or aim at a nearby swimmer to share it.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.expeditio: Click a preparation slot to assign this ability.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.distracti: Spend a snowball to distract an idle zombie. Aim at a block it can walk to.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.exception: Hand crafting can yield an exceptional copy. Higher Crafting skill improves your chance.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.reason.eq: Wear the exceptional accessory to use this ability.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.reason.br: Breathe air for two seconds to charge your necklace.
The target doesn’t need a breath.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.breath_re: %s shared a stored breath with you.
